verdict.rationale: Restate's versioning docs describe immutable deployments, and state that it 'makes sure that requests start and end on the same version' by routing retry attempts to the same endpoint. That directly delivers in-flight runs finishing on their original code while new deployments take new traffic. The CLI manages deployments, and ctx.run journaling supports determinism. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of version pinning, and detailed evidence on draining and retiring old deployments (the immutable-deployment doc excerpt is truncated).
